# `start_ai_process`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Start the AI image-processing worker on the current or a named image.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit and 32-bit builds) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xdb4b0, ParserDenoiseParams @0xaf380, startDeNoise @0x3f16b0 (64-bit build) |

Depending on view mode and master-process selection the 64-bit build may relay the request to the peer process before any local validation. Locally it validates the parameters, stops any previous AI worker (possibly blocking), expands name, checks the file is accessible, loads the image, computes the estimate and starts the named worker. A success reply acknowledges the thread start, not completion. On completion the AIProcess function event carries ori_name and dst_name strings (the formatter emits only in the complete state); exact timing and the output file names are unresolved. Firmware 9.75, app 3.4.0 replaces the old view-mode test with the relay-only form of the common relay check (it relays to the peer process when needed and runs no occupancy probe, so no 203 or 524 comes from it; READ in 64-bit firmware 9.75), the wire effect is INFERRED and the 32-bit build was not checked.

Side effects: Stops any previous AI worker, loads an image, starts the AI worker thread which later writes processed output.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"start_ai_process"`. [READ] |
| `params` | object | yes | - | Object params only; arrays, scalars and null are treated as no keys and then fail the required numeric members with 108. Numeric members are validated in the order brightness, contrast, saturation. The app DTO also has a sharp member; the firmware reads no such key. [READ] |
| `params.name` | string | no | empty string = current image | Image to process, resolved against the image root. Default empty selects the current image. Non-string (including null) is rejected with 105. [READ] |
| `params.crop` | array<integer> | no | [-1,0,0,0,0,0,0,0] | Crop polygon as up to eight integers. Absent defaults to [-1,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]; only the first eight elements are read, short or empty arrays leave the rest at default, extras are ignored. A negative first value means no crop. INFERRED to be four (x,y) corner pairs in image pixels; no bounds or order validation. Non-integer element is rejected with 104, non-array or null with 102. [READ] |
| `params.brightness` | number | yes | - | Brightness adjustment. Integer or real; no range or clamp. Missing, null or other type is rejected with 108. [READ] |
| `params.contrast` | number | yes | - | Contrast adjustment. Integer or real; no range or clamp. Rejected with 108 as for brightness. [READ] |
| `params.saturation` | number | yes | - | Saturation adjustment. Integer or real; no range or clamp. Rejected with 108 as for brightness. [READ] |
| `params.dbe` | array<integer> | no | [] | Background-extraction points as a flat integer list, INFERRED to be (x,y) pixel pairs. Absent defaults to empty; all elements are read, no size limit. Null, non-array, non-integer element or odd element count is rejected with 102. [READ] |

## Reply

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `jsonrpc` | string | no | - | (error) Added by the socket layer (reply object constructor), not the handler fragment. Normally present; absent on a stop_func relay-failure reply. Receivers MUST NOT require it. Fixed value `"2.0"`. [READ; also OBSERVED on the wire (2026-10-12)] |
| `Timestamp` | string | no | - | (error) Decimal string `<seconds>.<nanoseconds>` with exactly nine fractional digits, formatted with `%ld.%09ld` from clock_gettime clock id 1. Linux clock id 1 is CLOCK_MONOTONIC, so the value is monotonic time, not wall-clock or Unix time (INFERRED from the clock id). On replies it is added by the socket layer and is normally present; receivers MUST NOT require it on replies (absent on a stop_func relay-failure reply). On events it is always written by the event constructor. [READ; wire shape also OBSERVED (2026-10-12)] |
| `method` | string | if the request had an id and a string method (handler errors and 103), except a locally built stop_func relay failure | - | (error) The request method, echoed. Absent on dispatcher errors 100 and 200 and on a stop_func relay failure. [READ] |
| `error` | string | yes | - | (error) Message looked up from the code; unknown codes yield "fail to operate". [READ] |
| `code` | integer | yes | - | (error) Nonzero. A requested code of 0 is coerced to 207. [READ] |
| `id` | any | yes | - | (error) The request id echoed with its JSON type; null on dispatcher errors 100 and 200, where it is the only way to recognise the reply and cannot be matched to a request. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 105 | name present but not a string | `expected string param` |
| 102 | crop present but not an array, or dbe malformed (not an array, non-integer element, odd length) | `invalid params` |
| 104 | A crop element among the first eight is not an integer | `expected int param` |
| 108 | brightness, contrast or saturation missing or not a number | `expected float param` |
| 212 | Worker thread could not be created | `fail to create thread` |
| 300 | Relay: main-process user context is null | `internal error` |
| 207 | Image access, load or start failure with no code set (default) | `fail to operate` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

Image load and slave-transport error code sets are unresolved.

## Example

Request, defaults - Zero adjustments, whole current image (values invented):

```json
{"id":41,"method":"start_ai_process","params":{"brightness":0,"contrast":0,"saturation":0,"crop":[],"dbe":[]}}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"start_ai_process","result":{"estimated_sec":20},"code":0,"id":41}
```

Reply, error:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"start_ai_process","error":"expected float param","code":108,"id":42}
```
